messages:
Noah: Pushed a draft one-pager for Governance & Compliance comms — focused on security-first SLAs, deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), and routing guidance for security-led inbound. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFGhijk-quick-draft
Maya: Taking a look now. Can we call out 3 quick benchmark lines (p50/p95/p99 latency) and 1M-token cost estimates? Security teams care about predictable costs + tail latency.
Derek: Agree on benchmarks. For field moves, CTA should be "Book a Security Workshop" + a playbook PDF. Also recommend tagging inbound leads with: security-sla, private-deploy, dedicated-request.
Ashley: Layout idea: top nav with TL;DR, left column: what we guarantee (SLA bullets), middle: deployment map + routing diagram, right: customer checklist + CTA button. One hero callout for compliance certifications. I can mock a compact visual for the one-pager.
Sam: Webinar idea: "Latency, Cost, and Compliance: Choosing the Right Deployment Mode" — short demo of failover (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and a benchmark segment. Field-friendly. I can host with Derek.
Noah: Nice. Two asks: (1) include a short benchmark narrative (one paragraph) that explains the tradeoffs — e.g., hosted = fastest onboarding, best for new PLG usage; dedicated = consistent throughput for production; private = max isolation + KMS/HSM. (2) Add exact inbound routing rules we can drop into HubSpot/Intercom.
Maya: Draft benchmark paragraph suggestion: "Redwood performance profiles show median latency improvements of 2–3x between hosted small-batch configs and dedicated pools at scale; P99 tail improvements are biggest with dedicated GPU reservation and KV caching enabled, while private deployments offer strict network isolation and customer-managed keys for regulated workloads." Thoughts?
Derek: Good. For SLA copy: propose "SLA: 99.9% service availability (Dedicated & Hosted), SLO: P99 < 250ms for <2k token requests on Dedicated pool (dependent on model family). Private deployments: contractual SLA options." Keep numbers conservative.
Ashley: I'll replace the vague bits with icons for SOC2, ISO27001, FedRAMP (where applicable) and short tooltip text: "Encryption at rest & in transit, customer KMS support, audit logs." Also reduce copy to one-liners for skimmability.
Noah: Example inbound routing rules (copy/paste for ops):
```yaml
- match: has_tag("security-sla") or text_contains(["private", "vpc", "kms", "iso", "soc2"])
  assign: security-ops
  priority: high
- match: has_tag("dedicated-request")
  assign: ae-dedicated
  priority: medium
- match: source == "webinar" and text_contains("benchmark")
  assign: growth-webinar-follows
  priority: low
```
Derek: Perfect. We'll also add a manual checkbox for "needs legal review" to catch unusual compliance asks.
Maya: Add a short benchmark table snippet for the one-pager (I'll paste numbers):
```text
Config       | Typical P50 | Typical P99 | Cost / 1M tokens
Hosted small | 80ms        | 450ms       | $120
Dedicated    | 60ms        | 220ms       | $75
Private      | 70ms        | 200ms       | $95 (incl infra)
```
Noah: Those numbers look good as illustrative examples (call out: sample results, actual varies by model & context). Also add a short note on fallback behavior: "Automatic fallback to compatible model tier under capacity constraints."
doc-bot: Google Doc updated by Noah: "governance-comms-onepager (v3)"
Sam: I can draft the webinar script: 20m talk + 10m live Q&A — emphasize routing & how to operationalize SLAs. Count me in. :raised_hands:
Derek: I'll prepare a 1-page field playbook with top objections: pricing, migration effort, audited controls. Will include sample customer questions + suggested responses.
Ashley: Uploading two visual comps to the doc now — optimizing for print + slide share.
Noah: Timeline: finalize copy + benchmarks by EOD today, Ashley to attach flattened PDF for Sales Toolkit, Derek to ship field playbook by tomorrow morning, Sam to block a webinar date next week. If anyone can't hit these, shout here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
